notes.title: TESLA GUN
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34959999/23a39d67d7506cbc368c7afb04f4704cd24d0370.gif[/img]

We continue to work on the game and in this update we have prepared for you a new ultimatum weapon - [b]Tesla gun![/b] It is available with the accumulation of a large number of coins. Tesla cannon fires a lightning bolt that incinerates all enemies half a mile ahead, even flying ones.

Good luck everyone! And do not forget that in order to pass the level to the end, it is necessary to purchase an improvement of the car - a gas tank.

notes.title: A MORE INTENSE GAMEPLAY NOW
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34959999/902d3efe37a4f9d6b9c350d20d52b0cfe846bbbf.gif[/img]

We keep working on the game and in this update we've made a number of changes for you, which make the gameplay much more intense. The most important change is more aggressive zombies. Now they're not only running at us, they're clinging to the hood of our car. Besides, now we have gas stations where we can fill up with gas. Now we can shoot and knock off zombies' heads and they'll get into our car. You can shoot annoying ravens now and get coins for it.
 
Besides, there is certainly a number of other minor improvements in this update, such as the ability to customize the graphics. Also some errors were eliminated, and graphics was optimized.
 
Have a good game, everybody! And don't forget that you need to buy a car improvement — a gas tank for game-level completion.
